item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong between tomorrow night and Monday morning. Temperatures will fall appreciably and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will improve with cool mornings over southern China early next week. It will be rainy over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Then another cold front will affect southern China during the weekend.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with mist. A few rain patches later. Temperatures falling at night.

PSR: Medium Low
